guitar.modelsText: Fernandes Stratocaster copy "Blue" / Gibson Les Paul Junior
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Billie Joe Armstrong's battered Fernandes "Blue" guitar is extremely well documented as his main guitar for decades.

tone.target: tight mid-scooped punk crunch with bright attack
tone.profile: tight mid-scooped punk crunch with bright attack
tone.summary: A classic punk crunch setup using a Boost for bite, followed by an aggressive Marshall-style amp model (UK 45) and a standard 4x12 cabinet, keeping effects minimal to maintain tightness.
corrections: keep bass low but not modern metal

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in punk rhythm playing.
Simulate the Tube Screamer-style boost for upper-mid bite and tight attack.
blocks.gap: The Boost model is used as a general overdrive/boost, approximating the classic TS sound needed for punk crunch.

blocks.purpose: No dedicated distortion needed; the Boost and Amp model will provide sufficient crunch.
blocks.gap: The target tone is 'crunch' rather than heavy distortion, so this module is bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall-style punk crunch and upper-mid bite.
